content: Claude Memory Agent (memory_agent/) is stdlib Python: SQLite + FTS5 store, MCP stdio server, SessionStart/Stop hooks. Chosen because it needs no pip install (works on Termux), costs nothing, and cloud containers are disposable, so memory persists through the committed .claude/memory/snapshot.jsonl. No embeddings: keyword BM25 + importance + recency.
